neighbours.label: the object of causative 'make' (make X look/seem/feel ..., make X into ...), at the object token
fire: Years of bad press have made her seem cold and distant to voters.
The bright paint really makes this room feel much bigger than it is.
His clumsy jokes only made us like him even less.
A good editor can make your rough draft into a polished essay.
Losing the final made the whole team doubt their coach.
Adding lemon zest makes the sauce taste fresher and lighter.
That one viral video made Lopez a household name overnight.
The new glasses make me look like my grandfather.
quiet: Years of bad press have followed her through every campaign.
The bright paint really covers this room in a cheerful glow.
His clumsy jokes only annoyed us more as the night went on.
A good editor can read your rough draft in a single afternoon.
Losing the final hurt the whole team for several weeks.
Adding lemon zest to the sauce takes only a minute or two.
That one viral video reached Lopez's fans overnight.
The new glasses sit on the shelf next to my grandfather's watch.

notes: Card: peaks on him/it/them/this after make/made; output promotes ' into', ' seem', ' feel'. Probe: made him look 0.60, made them run 0.37, made a cake 0.10, helped him 0.00.
